title.en: An Act to Amend Sections One, three, and Six of Act Numbered thirty-Five Hundred, as Amended By Act Numbered thirty-Six Hundred and thirty-Seven, and for Other

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-six
hundred and thirty-seven, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. The sum of five million pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, to constitute a revolving fund for the construction of permanent bridges on insular or
provincial roads in the Philippines, which shall be expended under the supervision of the Secretary of Public
Works and Communications. Said bridges shall be declared toll bridges for a period not exceeding twenty
years and tolls shall be collected from all traffic using such bridges in accordance with rates to be fixed by a
board composed of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications as chairman, the Secretary of Finance,
and the Secretary of the Interior and Labor, as members: Provided, however, That no toll charges shall be
collected from pedestrians."

Section three of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 3. The provincial treasurer of the province where a toll bridge is constructed in accordance with this
Act, shall be in charge of toll collections and toll collectors duly bonded, shall be appointed by him at salaries
to be approved by the Secretary of Public Works and Communications chargeable to toll collections. The
collections made by the provincial treasurer from each toll bridge, after deducting the salaries of toll
collectors, shall be turned over to the Insular Treasurer and credited to the revolving fund, herein created, and
shall be available for the construction of other bridges until all important bridges that can be financed under
the provisions of this Act are completed when the balance remaining in said revolving fund shall revert to the
general fund of the Insular Treasury: Provided, however, That the cost of constructing and maintaining
suitable gates and quarters for collectors to facilitate the collection of tolls, including the purchase of
necessary equipment for checking, verifying and safeguarding funds collected, shall be considered a proper
and legitimate part of the cost of collecting said tolls."

Section six of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 6. The board created in section one of this Act may also authorize, alter public advertisement in the
Official Gazette for a period of not less than ten days, any individual, firm, company, or corporation, provided
such individual is a citizen of the United States or of the Philippines or such firm, company, or corporation is
owned and capitalized by citizens of the United States or of the Philippine Islands, that submits the most
advantageous proposal to construct at its own expense any bridge designated by said board in accordance with
plans and specifications prepared by the Bureau of Public Works and subject to the supervision of said
Bureau. Such individual, firm, company, or corporation shall be further authorized to collect tolls for a period
not exceeding twenty years, the schedule for which shall be approved by said board."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 18, 1933.
